cohort: Births at ≥22 weeks of gestation in 2015 and 2019 in 28 European countries
finding: Caesarean section rates and trends varied among 28 European countries from 2015 to 2019, with decreasing rates in nine countries, maintained rates in seven, and increasing rates in 12.
mod_finding: In countries with the greatest increase in CS rates (>1%), the absolute contributions of nulliparous term cephalic singletons with spontaneous labor, induction of labor, prelabor CS, and preterm cephalic singletons to the overall CS rate tended to increase.
